title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Table on Education and Argumentation
prompt:
The table below shows the results of a survey conducted in 2023 among first-year university students in four countries about the main strategies they use to construct written arguments in academic essays. The survey asked students to rate the importance of each strategy on a scale from 1 (not important) to 5 (very important). The table displays the percentage of students in each country who rated each strategy as 4 or 5.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟雅思学术类写作Task 1练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请根据表格信息写一篇至少150词的报告，概括主要特征并进行比较。注意：不要表达个人观点或解释原因，只需客观描述数据。建议先找出2-4个最显著的对比特征（如某国在多个策略上比例最高或最低），再组织段落：引言改写题目，概述段总结主要趋势，主体段详细比较具体数据。确保使用准确的数据引用和比较语言。
